statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The diagnosis codes are I25.10 and I34.0
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring is medically necessary to evaluate the origin of these symptoms
